key_catalyst: Brent crude surging past $100 on Houthi attacks and Iran escalation, driving an oil-led inflation/yield shock into growth stocks
reasoning: Three escalating, mutually reinforcing catalysts hit simultaneously today: Brent broke $100 on widening Houthi/Iran conflict (banks warning of $120-146), Alphabet and Tesla each posted negative free cash flow while raising AI capex, triggering a sector-wide re-rating, and new Section 301 tariffs took effect. The market did not shrug this off—QQQ fell -1.37% today on top of -1.90% on 2026-07-23, and yields pushing to 4.70% keep compressing the long-duration mega-caps that dominate the index. Intel's after-hours beat is a genuine but narrow offset that does not neutralize an oil shock and a broad AI-monetization repricing still in motion.
